title: Binary ordinary evaluation comparison
statement: Fix the ordinary fixed-scalar derived categories, adjunctions, actual ordinary product $\Omega$ and evaluation composite $\rho$ of [def-pur-ordinary-product-transpose-data]. For arbitrary schemes $W,X,Y,B$, maps $r:W\to X$, $t:W\to Y$, $f:X\to B$, $g:Y\to B$ with a cartesian square $rf=tg$, and arbitrary unbounded $K\in D_X$, $L\in D_Y$, the inverse adjunction Hom bijection of $L_{tg}\dashv R_{tg}$ sends $\Omega_{f,g}(K,L)$ to $\rho_{r,t}(R_fK,R_gL;\varepsilon_{f,K},\varepsilon_{g,L})$. No properness, boundedness, constructibility or invertibility of exchange or projection is assumed.

proof.text: Transpose the outer projection and its two signed symmetries. Symmetry naturality and pullback symmetry compatibility cancel the two swaps, leaving identity tensored with the second counit. Identify the successive transpose with the composite transpose through the specified direct-image compositor. Tensor-composition compatibility gives exactly the displayed binary evaluation. The fixed-scalar comparisons can be computed on K-flat representatives, where these are ordinary tensor and inverse-image equations, and then descended by their universal properties.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryBinaryProductTranspose {W X Y B : Scheme.{u}}
    {r : W ⟶ X} {t : W ⟶ Y} {f : X ⟶ B} {g : Y ⟶ B}
    (sq : IsPullback r t f g) (K : P.ordinaryCategory X) (L : P.ordinaryCategory Y) :
    ((P.ordinaryAdj (t ≫ g)).homEquiv _ _).symm (P.ordinaryProduct sq K L) =
      P.ordinaryBinaryEvaluation sq ((P.ordinaryPush f).obj K)
        ((P.ordinaryPush g).obj L) K L
        ((P.ordinaryAdj f).counit.app K) ((P.ordinaryAdj g).counit.app L)
